tyranitar.name: Tyranitar
tyranitar.role: The best Pokemon in ADV OU - versatile wallbreaker, sweeper, or support

dragon_dance.name: Dragon Dance
dragon_dance.description: Incredibly dangerous cleaner and late-game sweeper. Bulk and Lum Berry allow safe setup. HP Bug hits Celebi and Claydol.
dragon_dance.usage_tips: Bring out in endgame to finish matches. Can often get two boosts with proper support.

choice_band.name: Choice Band
choice_band.description: Devastating wallbreaker. Focus Punch 2HKOs Flygon, Skarmory, and Swampert on predicted switches.
choice_band.usage_tips: Use aggressive double switches. Being Choice-locked is dangerous vs offense. Weak to Dugtrio without bulk investment.

mixed_attacker.name: Mixed Attacker
mixed_attacker.description: Harder to switch into than pure physical sets. Fire Blast threatens Skarmory and Forretress.
mixed_attacker.usage_tips: Good for luring and weakening specific checks.

substitute.name: Substitute
substitute.description: SubPunch set for breaking through bulky Pokemon.
substitute.usage_tips: Forces 50/50s and can snowball with correct predictions.

checks_and_counters.notes: Few true counters exist; most checks can be overwhelmed with correct coverage or predictions

team_support.offensive: Wants support to wear down checks. Choice Band Metagross lures and removes Skarmory with Explosion.
team_support.defensive: Sand Stream helps chip down opponents; pairs well with Spikes

skarmory.name: Skarmory
skarmory.role: Best Spikes user in the tier; premier physical wall

spikes.name: Defensive Spiker
spikes.evs: 252 HP / 4 Def / 252 SpD (or 252 HP / 232 Def / 24 Spe)
spikes.description: Sets up Spikes and phazes opponents for chip damage. 24 Spe outspeeds Adamant Tyranitar.
spikes.usage_tips: Careful nature helps survive Magneton Thunderbolt to get 2 Spikes vs Mag teams. Whirlwind + Drill Peck is illegal - use Roar with Drill Peck.
spikes.move_legality_note: Whirlwind and Drill Peck cannot be used together due to move tutor restrictions

yolo_skarm.name: Yolo Skarm (Anti-Magneton)
yolo_skarm.description: Uses HP Ground and max Speed investment to outrun HP Fire Magneton sets. HP Fire requires a suboptimal Speed IV of 30, so max Speed Skarmory outspeeds and can KO with HP Ground.
yolo_skarm.usage_tips: Not a great set overall, but exists as a surprise option. Sacrifices bulk for Magneton matchup.

hard_counters: Magnet Magneton is harder to survive
checks_and_counters.notes: Anti-Spikes teams are necessarily anti-Skarmory. Getting one layer of Spikes is the most effective - 1 to 2 layers only adds ~4% damage.

blissey.name: Blissey
blissey.role: Best special wall in the tier; forces teams to run physical attackers

defensive.name: Defensive Support
defensive.evs: 106 HP / 252 Def / 152 SpA (or 16 HP / 252 Def / 240 SpA Bold)
defensive.description: Patches up Skarmory's mediocre special defense. Ice Beam OHKOs Salamence.
defensive.usage_tips: Bold with Def investment handles physical threats better; SpA investment nails Dugtrio after Spikes.

offensive.name: Offensive
offensive.description: More offensive oriented, punishing Steel-types with Fire Blast.
offensive.usage_tips: Fire Blast surprises Metagross and Skarmory switch-ins.

checks_and_counters.notes: If Blissey usage is too low, it will get exploited

dugtrio.name: Dugtrio
dugtrio.role: Premier trapper; keeps frail ground-weaks out of the tier

choice_band.name: Choice Band
choice_band.description: Traps and eliminates key threats. With Spikes, can OHKO Tyranitar, Metagross, etc.

dugtrio.notes: Singlehandedly keeps frail ground-weaks out of the tier. Amazing synergy with Skarmory on stall teams.

zapdos.name: Zapdos
zapdos.role: Versatile special attacker and pivot; great lead to prevent early Spikes

offensive.name: Offensive
moves: Hidden Power Ice / Hidden Power Grass
offensive.description: Timid outspeeds mixed/DD Salamence, Timid Moltres, defensive Gengar. HP Ice vs HP Grass are same set with different targets.
offensive.usage_tips: Great lead - prevents early Spikes, threatens SubPass vs favorable matchups (Salamence, Skarmory, Metagross).

team_support.notes: Baton Pass maintains momentum by eliminating need to read switches

salamence.name: Salamence
salamence.role: Powerful wallbreaker and sweeper with Intimidate utility

choice_band.name: Choice Band
choice_band.description: Potent wallbreaker that can OHKO or 2HKO most of ADV OU.
choice_band.usage_tips: Intimidate provides defensive utility on switch-in.

mixed.name: Mixed Attacker
mixed.description: Most used set - threatens Swampert, Metagross, Celebi with coverage moves.
mixed.usage_tips: Harder to switch into than pure physical.

dragon_dance.name: Dragon Dance
dragon_dance.usage_tips: Requires checks to be weakened first.

checks_and_counters.notes: Mixed sets are hardest to switch into

metagross.name: Metagross
metagross.role: Versatile Steel-type; physical tank, wallbreaker, or sweeper; part of Rock Resists core

choice_band.name: Choice Band
choice_band.description: Common lead. Explosion removes Skarmory and enables teammates.
choice_band.usage_tips: Explosion timing is critical - use it to remove key defensive threats.

houdini.name: Houdini (Lead Explosion)
houdini.description: Named after a famous ladder player who always used a Metagross named Houdini. Lead with intent to use Explosion early to remove a key threat and enable your team.
houdini.usage_tips: KO ends turn completely - denies opponent their turn. Use this to pivot into a trapper or disrupt the enemy and get a good pivot in.

agility.name: Agility
agility.description: Physical check that can sweep and close out games.
agility.usage_tips: Set up on Pokemon that can't threaten it.

checks_and_counters.notes: Explosion makes it hard to safely switch in. Part of Rock Resists core (Swampert/Metagross/Flygon).

swampert.name: Swampert
swampert.role: Bulky pivot with excellent typing; only weak to Grass

mixed_offensive.name: Mixed Offensive
mixed_offensive.description: Breaks common defensive backbones. Hydro Pump 2-3HKOs almost anything that doesn't resist it.
mixed_offensive.usage_tips: Ice Beam nails SpD Zapdos, Grass-types, Salamence. EQ pressures Blissey and Jirachi.

epic_swampert.name: SubPunch (Epic Swampert)
epic_swampert.description: Forces 50/50s and breaks through typical checks.

checks_and_counters.notes: Excellent type synergy with Zapdos

gengar.name: Gengar
gengar.role: Offensive spinblocker; spreads status and generates momentum

offensive.name: Offensive
offensive.description: HP Grass stops Swampert and Tyranitar from walling. Ice Punch OHKOs Salamence. Taunt prevents healing/setup.
offensive.usage_tips: Explosion blows through Blissey for teammates. Will-O-Wisp helps vs physical offense.

checks_and_counters.notes: Key Pokemon for blocking Rapid Spin

starmie.name: Starmie
starmie.role: Fast Rapid Spinner with offensive presence

offensive_spinner.name: Offensive Rapid Spin
offensive_spinner.description: Spins successfully almost 100% of the time with offensive pressure. Bolt-Beam coverage.
offensive_spinner.usage_tips: Can run less Speed (176 EVs outspeeds Adamant Dugtrio, 136 for Salamence/Zapdos).

defensive.name: Defensive
defensive.description: Better checks physical threats like Tyranitar, Metagross, Swampert, Aerodactyl.

checks_and_counters.notes: Cannot play offense and defense simultaneously

magneton.name: Magneton
magneton.role: Steel-type trapper; enables Dragon-types, Spikeless strategies, and Crocune

hp_fire.name: HP Fire Trapper
hp_fire.description: Traps and KOs Skarmory. HP Fire is essential for the trap.
hp_fire.usage_tips: HP Fire requires imperfect Speed IV (30) which makes Magneton slower - Yolo Skarm exploits this.

magnet.name: Magnet Magneton
magnet.description: Holds the Magnet item for boosted Thunderbolt power. Eliminates Skarmory more effectively because Skarmory typically runs SpD EVs. Also more effective vs Metagross, Jirachi, and Forretress.
magnet.usage_tips: The elimination of Skarmory allows physical threats to be more potent. Magnet gives the extra power needed vs SpD Skarmory.

endure_salac.name: Endure + Salac
endure_salac.description: After Salac boost, outspeeds entire OU except Jolteon/Aerodactyl - including Dugtrio.
endure_salac.usage_tips: Becomes faster than Dugtrio, can't be trapped. Checks offensive Starmie in a pinch.

magneton.notes: Essential for teams weak to Steel-types; enables Dragon/Flying offense and Crocune strategies

celebi.name: Celebi
celebi.role: Versatile support and setup sweeper; special wall on balance

calm_mind.name: Calm Mind
calm_mind.description: Counters Gengar, Suicune, Milotic, Swampert. HP Fire variant hits Skarmory/Metagross/Jirachi.
calm_mind.usage_tips: Psychic hits Taunt Gengar, Moltres, Roar Zapdos hard after CM boost.

baton_pass.name: Baton Pass
baton_pass.description: Grabs boosts and passes to sweepers like Agility Metagross.
baton_pass.usage_tips: Used to lure things Dugtrio can trap.

perish_song.name: Perish Song Stall
perish_song.description: Stall wincon - Perish Song prevails in endgame.

checks_and_counters.notes: Natural Cure makes it very hard to status

jirachi.name: Jirachi
jirachi.role: Versatile Steel-type; special wall, Wish support, or Calm Mind sweeper

defensive_wish.name: Defensive Wish
defensive_wish.description: Special wall that keeps teammates healthy with Wish. Body Slam has 60% para chance with Serene Grace.
defensive_wish.usage_tips: Effective against Aerodactyl, Curse Snorlax, mixed Salamence.

calm_mind.name: Calm Mind
calm_mind.description: Setup sweeper that can snowball if unchecked.
calm_mind.usage_tips: Needs checks removed before attempting to sweep.

checks_and_counters.notes: Serene Grace Body Slam is very annoying

aerodactyl.name: Aerodactyl
aerodactyl.role: Fastest Choice Band user; best revenge killer in the tier

choice_band.name: Choice Band
choice_band.description: Late-game cleaner. After Tyranitar weakens rock resists and bulky waters, Aerodactyl cleans with fast Rock Slide.
choice_band.usage_tips: Extremely threatening in late game. One of the most annoying Pokemon for CM spam teams.

checks_and_counters.notes: Play carefully against Aerodactyl - it can end games quickly

claydol.name: Claydol
claydol.role: Best Rapid Spinner in the tier due to Levitate; immune to Spikes and Sand chip

rapid_spin.name: Rapid Spin Support
rapid_spin.description: Levitates over Spikes, doesn't take Sand chip as Ground-type. Refresh absorbs status.
rapid_spin.usage_tips: Best spinner for teams that need reliable hazard removal.

checks_and_counters.notes: Struggles to pressure Gengar, making Spin difficult vs dedicated spinblockers

suicune.name: Suicune
suicune.role: Bulky Water that can set up with Calm Mind; Crocune is a famous wincon

calm_mind.name: Calm Mind
calm_mind.description: Can become very hard to break after Calm Mind boosts.
calm_mind.usage_tips: Preserve your Suicune check - it can snowball games if you lose Zapdos.

crocune.name: Crocune (Rest/Sleep Talk)
crocune.description: Created by Cromat. The ultimate wincon on Magneton teams - once Skarmory is removed, nothing can Roar it out if Suicune is the last Pokemon.
crocune.usage_tips: Great on Magneton teams because Skarmory's Roar can't affect Suicune if it's your last mon. Pair with Zapdos/Dugtrio core for special offense.

checks_and_counters.notes: Crocune + Magneton removes Skarmory's ability to phaze. As last mon, nothing stops it.

snorlax.name: Snorlax
snorlax.role: Special wall; beats Rain teams and special offense

curselax.name: Curse
curselax.description: Sets up Curse and becomes very hard to take down. Shadow Ball hits Gengar.
curselax.usage_tips: Excellent vs Rain teams and special offense.

checks_and_counters.notes: Key anti-Rain Pokemon

flygon.name: Flygon
flygon.role: Rock resist with Levitate; checks DD Tyranitar and Aerodactyl; part of Rock Resists core

choice_band.name: Choice Band
choice_band.description: Strong wallbreaker with good Speed. Quick Attack picks off weakened threats.
choice_band.usage_tips: Excellent for checking DD Tyranitar and Aerodactyl. Fire Blast hits Skarmory on the switch.

defensive.name: Defensive
defensive.description: Defensive pivot for checking DD Tar and Aerodactyl. Fits Superman teams well alongside SpDef Zapdos.
defensive.usage_tips: Great partnership with Wish Jirachi. Checking Fire-types is underrated - keep it healthy for Ttar/Aero.

checks_and_counters.notes: Part of the Rock Resists core (Swampert/Metagross/Flygon) - all resist Rock Slide

heracross.name: Heracross
heracross.role: Powerful physical wallbreaker; Guts punishes Will-O-Wisp

choice_band.name: Choice Band
choice_band.description: Devastating wallbreaker. Megahorn 2HKOs most of the tier. Focus Punch destroys Skarmory on the switch.
choice_band.usage_tips: Sleep Talk lets you absorb Spore from Breloom. Guts boosts Attack when burned.

swords_dance.name: Swords Dance
swords_dance.description: Setup sweeper that can clean late game.
swords_dance.usage_tips: Salac Berry gives crucial Speed boost in endgame.

checks_and_counters.notes: After Dugtrio and Spikes, Heracross is the third best reason to run a Ground immune

milotic.name: Milotic
milotic.role: Bulky Water; alternative to Suicune with Marvel Scale and Recover

defensive.name: Defensive Wall
defensive.description: Physical wall with reliable recovery. Marvel Scale boosts Defense when statused.
defensive.usage_tips: Part of the Milotic/Celebi Balance archetype. Susceptible to 2HKO after Spikes and Sand chip.

checks_and_counters.notes: Milotic/Celebi core relies on Recover - very susceptible to chip damage

moltres.name: Moltres
moltres.role: Powerful Fire-type that threatens TSS teams; knocks Celebi/Jirachi/Metagross down a peg

offensive.name: Offensive
offensive.description: Fire Blast threatens OHKOs on Metagross, Skarmory, Forretress, Magneton, Jirachi, Celebi, Heracross, Breloom.
offensive.usage_tips: HP Grass hits Swampert. Very dangerous for TSS teams to face.

bulky.name: Bulky
bulky.usage_tips: 228 Spe is enough for most threats. Rest provides recovery.

checks_and_counters.notes: Charizard and Moltres knock Celebi, Jirachi, and Metagross down a peg

medicham.name: Medicham
medicham.role: Devastating wallbreaker with Pure Power (doubles Attack); 2HKOs Skarmory with Focus Punch

choice_band.name: Choice Band
choice_band.description: Pure Power + Choice Band = devastating power. Focus Punch 2HKOs Skarmory (hits before Whirlwind).
choice_band.usage_tips: Needs prediction to work at its best. A bit too slow to sweep but makes for a great wall breaker.

substitute.name: SubPunch
substitute.description: A force to be reckoned with if it gets behind a Sub.
substitute.usage_tips: Only Snorlax, Regice, Porygon2, and Blissey can safely switch into any of its moves.

checks_and_counters.notes: Pure Power effectively gives it 120 base Attack - one of the strongest physical attackers in the tier

raikou.name: Raikou
raikou.role: Fast special attacker and Calm Mind sweeper; scary late-game threat

calm_mind.name: Calm Mind
moves: Hidden Power Ice / Hidden Power Grass
calm_mind.description: Late-game sweeper that's very scary when its counter is removed.
calm_mind.usage_tips: Only really good in late-game. Needs a lot of support to do well.

bulky_roar.name: Bulky Roar
bulky_roar.description: Defensive pivot that shuffles the opponent. Really deserves more usage.
bulky_roar.usage_tips: Roar racks up Spikes damage. Rest provides longevity.

checks_and_counters.notes: Calm Mind users like Celebi, Jirachi, and Raikou are staples of Charizard-based archetypes

forretress.name: Forretress
forretress.role: Spikes + Rapid Spin role compression; checks CM Celebi; grounded so weak to its own Spikes

spikes_spin.name: Spikes + Spin
spikes_spin.description: Great role compression: Spikes + Spin + CM Celebi check. Can limit Skarmory's Spikes to zero most of the time.
spikes_spin.usage_tips: Being grounded makes it weak to Spikes itself. Explosion is useful for removing threats.

checks_and_counters.notes: A single Spike gives so much momentum - getting one layer up is the most effective use of Spikes

breloom.name: Breloom
breloom.role: Spore user with high Attack; part of Breloom/Charizard spikeless offense popularized by Undisputed

spore_punch.name: Spore + Focus Punch
spore_punch.description: Spore puts something to sleep, then Focus Punch does massive damage.
spore_punch.usage_tips: Stun Spore provides additional status. Substitute protects from revenge kills.

subseed.name: SubSeed
subseed.description: Wrecks fast frail Pokemon with Focus Punch while seeding bulky Pokemon like Jirachi.
subseed.usage_tips: Mach Punch provides priority for revenge killing. Part of Undisputed's famous Breloom/Charizard team.

checks_and_counters.notes: Breloom and Charizard both moved from UUBL to OU thanks to Undisputed's team

charizard.name: Charizard
charizard.role: Fearsome mixed wallbreaker; very dangerous for TSS teams; part of Breloom/Charizard archetype

mixed.name: Mixed Attacker
moves: Hidden Power Grass / Hidden Power Ice
mixed.description: Fire Blast threatens OHKOs on Metagross, Skarmory, Forretress, Magneton, Jirachi, Celebi. Focus Punch for Tyranitar, Beat Up for Blissey.
mixed.usage_tips: Beat Up with full team does ~60-70% to Blissey. HP Grass for Swampert. Great Speed tier.

checks_and_counters.notes: Part of Undisputed's famous spikeless offense with Breloom. CM users like Celebi, Jirachi, Raikou are staples of Charizard archetypes.

cloyster.name: Cloyster
cloyster.role: Spikes user that can set up on Suicune (unlike other Spikers); Explosion for momentum

spikes.name: Spikes + Boom
spikes.description: Can spike on Bulky Waters including Suicune - huge for viability. 246 Spe outspeeds all Tyranitar, Swampert, most Rest Zapdos and Bulky Celebi.
spikes.usage_tips: Spike + boom to quickly gain initiative. Unlike other spikers, can set up on Suicune which is huge.

checks_and_counters.notes: Well suited for PhysSpam or Spike Abuse teams

gyarados.name: Gyarados
gyarados.role: Dragon Dance sweeper with Intimidate; struggles that Water STAB doesn't match Attack stat

dragon_dance.name: Dragon Dance
dragon_dance.description: Setup sweeper. HP Flying or HP Rock for STAB since no physical Water moves worth using.
dragon_dance.usage_tips: Intimidate provides defensive utility. Rest Gyarados is a stallbreaking spikeless cleaner.

mixed.name: Mixed DD
mixed.description: Hydro Pump can catch switch-ins by surprise.
mixed.usage_tips: More versatile coverage but less raw power.

checks_and_counters.notes: Type's STAB doesn't match its dominant Attack stat - major limitation

kingdra.name: Kingdra
kingdra.role: Rain Dance sweeper with Swift Swim; more consistent than Ludicolo due to better bulk

rain_dance.name: Rain Dance Sweeper
rain_dance.description: Swift Swim doubles Speed in rain. More consistent than Ludicolo due to better bulk and ability to set up on sweepers late game.
rain_dance.usage_tips: A lastmon that requires legwork but has high potential upside.

checks_and_counters.notes: Dragon typing gives fewer weaknesses than Ludicolo

ludicolo.name: Ludicolo
ludicolo.role: Rain Dance sweeper; better power than Kingdra with STAB HP Grass for Milotic

rain_dance.name: Rain Dance Sweeper
rain_dance.description: Better power than Kingdra with invaluable STAB HP Grass for more damage to Milotic.
rain_dance.usage_tips: Cannot set up as easily as Kingdra. Used as cleaner on Special Spikeless Offense.

checks_and_counters.notes: Let down by inability to set up as easily as Kingdra

vaporeon.name: Vaporeon
vaporeon.role: Bulky Water with Wish and Baton Pass; SubPass support

baton_pass.name: SubPass
baton_pass.description: Passes Substitutes to teammates. Zapdos and Vaporeon use Baton Pass to lure things Dugtrio can trap.
baton_pass.usage_tips: SubPass still has its uses. Defensive sets likely outclassed by other Water walls.

checks_and_counters.notes: Water Absorb provides immunity to Water moves

dusclops.name: Dusclops
dusclops.role: Primary spinblocker; immune to Hi Jump Kick; supports Belly Drum sweepers with Memento

spinblocker.name: Defensive Spinblocker
spinblocker.description: Blocks Rapid Spin reliably. Immune to Hi Jump Kick and laughs off every Medicham attack except Trick.
spinblocker.usage_tips: Primary spinblocker option if you don't want Gengar.

memento.name: Memento Support
memento.description: Memento supports Belly Drum sweepers like Linoone by crippling the opponent.
memento.usage_tips: Niche set for dedicated Belly Drum teams.

checks_and_counters.notes: Immune to Normal and Fighting - perfect Medicham counter

weezing.name: Weezing
weezing.role: Physical wall with Levitate and Haze; stops setup sweepers and Baton Pass

defensive.name: Physical Wall
defensive.description: Haze stops setup sweepers and Baton Pass chains. Explosion for momentum.
defensive.usage_tips: Levitate makes it immune to Spikes and Ground moves.

checks_and_counters.notes: Haze is important for stopping Baton Pass chains

regice.name: Regice
regice.role: Special wall with massive SpD; stops Rain teams; one of few Medicham checks

special_wall.name: Special Wall
special_wall.description: 200 base SpD makes it an incredible special wall. One of few Pokemon that can safely switch into any Medicham move.
special_wall.usage_tips: Great vs Rain teams. Weak to many common physical attackers.

checks_and_counters.notes: Stops Rain teams cold but struggles vs physical offense

hariyama.name: Hariyama
hariyama.role: Bulky Fighting-type with Guts; alternative to Machamp with better HP

guts.name: Guts Attacker
guts.description: Guts boosts Attack when statused. Bulkier than Machamp but slower.
guts.usage_tips: Thick Fat can be used to check Fire/Ice attacks.

checks_and_counters.notes: Alternative to Machamp - trades speed for bulk

choice_band.name: Choice Band
choice_band.description: Powerful wallbreaker. Cross Chop has high crit rate.
choice_band.usage_tips: Soft check to Blissey. Guts punishes Will-O-Wisp.

checks_and_counters.notes: Trades bulk for more Attack compared to Hariyama

jolteon.name: Jolteon
jolteon.role: Fastest common Pokemon in OU; Baton Pass user; absorbs Electric moves

baton_pass.name: Baton Pass
baton_pass.description: Fastest Baton Passer. Volt Absorb gives Electric immunity.
baton_pass.usage_tips: Can pass Substitutes or Wishes. Speed is its main advantage over Raikou.

checks_and_counters.notes: 130 base Speed outspeeds everything except Aerodactyl and Electrode
